title: クレーンゲーム大成功！

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa, this is incredible! I never thought you'd get this many!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I guess still waters really do run deep—or however it's said. So basically, if I move the handle more like…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, don't worry about it. Just talking to myself. You did great, really.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely not thinking about stealing your technique or anything. ♪
